summary: Rebuilds a filtered array of 24-byte scene-instance entries on 'this'. When the entry count at this+0x174 is positive, frees the previous length-prefixed array at this+0x178 (per-element teardown via EmptyStub_0170, then FreeWrapper_7bcf), allocates a fresh length-prefixed array sized for the count, initializes each slot via ShortComputation_8e00, then walks two node lists (heads at this+0x100 and this+0x108). Nodes whose chain contains a sub-node carrying flag 0x20000 are appended into the array; nodes with the 0x40 flag at offset 4 are skipped. Always returns 0.

operations.description: Only rebuild when the entry count at this+0x174 is positive.
Proceed with freeing only when the existing array pointer at this+0x178 is non-null.
Walk the previous length-prefixed array (element count read from the dword preceding the array base) and run EmptyStub_0170 on each element.
Free the previous length-prefixed array block with FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Allocate a new length-prefixed array of 24-byte entries plus a 4-byte length header via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(24 * count + 4), and store the count in the header.
Initialize each 24-byte entry slot by stepping 6 dwords and calling ShortComputation_8e00 on each.
Store the new array pointer at this+0x178 (this[94]).
Walk the first node list from its head at this+0x100, following the forward link at node+260 for each node.
Skip a node when the byte flags at node+4 contain bit 0x40.
For a non-skipped node, walk its sub-list starting at the sub-list head pointer (node+236, hex 0xEC), chaining through the sub-node next pointer at offset 76 (0x4C).
Within each sub-node, follow the chain from its head at offset 516, stepping the forward link at chain+16 until a chain node with flag 0x20000 at chain+20 is found (a missing chain head is skipped).
Append a matching sub-node into the filtered array at this+0x178 + 16 + 24 * appendedCount.
Walk the second node list from its head at this+0x108, chaining through the next pointer at offset 76 (0x4C), using the sub-chain path anchored at this+0x30C and this+0x154.
For the second list, likewise walk the chain from the node offset-516 head, matching flag 0x20000 at chain+20, and append matching nodes into the filtered array.
